lane:
تشرين

تِشْرِينُ [in Chaldee ] _A Greek name of each of two months,_ (K,) _of the months of Autumn, called_ تِشْرِينُ الأَوَّلُ _and_ تِشْرِينُ الثَّانِى, [_and both together_ تِشْرِينَانِ, _the two Syrian months corresponding, respectively, to October and November O. S.,_] _before the two months whereof each is called_ كَانُونُ. (TA.)
